hook: Vikarabad's groundwater sank to *13.54 m*; new borewells now need MeeSeva permission
hook_b: Vikarabad's groundwater sank to *13.54 m*; new borewells now need MeeSeva permission
tldr: Vikarabad Collector Deepak Tiwari announced on Nov 19 that borewell permission applications will be accepted only through the MeeSeva portal; offline applications will not be accepted. The district's average groundwater level fell from 11.96 m in September to 13.54 m in October, after a 36% rainfall deficit from June to October.

beats.what: New borewells in Vikarabad need online MeeSeva permission and prior scientific clearance.
beats.why: Groundwater dropped 1.58 m in a month after a 36% monsoon deficit linked to El Nino.
beats.care: Drilling without permission can mean a seized borewell, a penalty and action under WALTA.
